title: A Heart-Friendly Swap
text: Peanut butter instead of butter! This toast is a little treat for your heart.
speaker: Chef Heart

title: Just Three Ingredients
text: One slice of whole-wheat bread, half an apple, and twenty grams of peanut butter.
speaker: Narrator

title: 01  Slice the Apple
text: Wash and core the apple, then slice it thinly. Keep the peel on!
speaker: Narrator

title: 02  Swap Your Spread
text: Choose one hundred percent peanuts, with no added sugar or salt. Spread it evenly!
speaker: Chef Heart

title: 03  Add the Apple
text: Layer on the apple slices. Crunchy toast, ready to go!
speaker: Chef Heart

title: Why Did Heart Choose This?
text: Still rich and nutty, even without butter! Here's why I picked this snack.
speaker: Chef Heart

title: Choose Unsaturated Fats
text: Replacing saturated fat with unsaturated fat can help manage LDL, the bad cholesterol.
speaker: Narrator

title: Swap It. Don't Just Add It.
text: So swap butter for peanut butter! It's a replacement, not an extra serving. That's the heart-friendly choice.
speaker: Narrator

title: Save Some for the Chef!
text: Taking care of your heart is great, but please don't eat the chef's snack too!
speaker: Chef Heart

title: Screenshot Your Next Snack!
text: Subscribe for your employee badge! Likes are your bonus!
speaker: Chef Heart
